summary: FD_TC_217_3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Exists in CS � Case < 30 Days � No Resolution � Wait Message
title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Exists in CS � Case < 30 Days � No Resolution � Wait Message
description:
Validates that when a claims company provides a case number that exists in CS, the case is less than 30 days old with no resolution, the system tells them to wait and the user accepts.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Claims Company. Passenger has opened a claim. Case number exists in CS. Case opened 15 days ago. No resolution on the case. User does NOT dispute.
